says: Taking all three. Values are now separated: the sky is one flat, even tone of fine horizontal lines, laid with a freshly sharpened point; the near gourd building is the darkest mass, cross-hatched all over; the left tower is a single mid tone; the back cluster and far skyline get lighter and sparser. The towers are bulbier gourds with narrow necks. The doorway now spills a wedge of white across the balcony floor, and the two figures carry a white rim so the eye lands on them. The windows vary: ovals, arches, slits and wide eyes, one with a silhouette in it.
